sections.title: ② 今日文法｜使役動詞 have/get、過去推論 must have + p.p.、目的子句 so that、時間子句 as soon as / until、主詞一致與分詞修飾
sections.markdown:
主題：**使役動詞 have/get、過去推論 must have + p.p.、目的子句 so that、時間子句 as soon as / until、主詞一致與分詞修飾**

### 規則 1｜使役動詞 have/get

have + object + past participle；get + person + to V。

> We had the sensors repaired. / We got the carrier to send a notice.

練習：`We had the faulty units _____ yesterday.`

答案：**replaced**。faulty units 被更換，用過去分詞。

### 規則 2｜過去推論 must have + p.p.

must have + 過去分詞表示對過去的強烈推論。

> The driver must have taken the wrong exit.

練習：`The engineer must have _____ the file.`

答案：**overlooked**。must have 後接過去分詞。

### 規則 3｜目的子句 so that

so that + 主詞 + 動詞表示目的。

> We updated the tracker so that customers could see the status.

練習：`The labels were printed early so that parcels _____ be shipped on time.`

答案：**could**。so that 後接完整子句。

### 規則 4｜時間子句 as soon as / until

談未來時，as soon as/when/until 的時間子句通常用現在式。

> We will dispatch the order as soon as testing is complete.

練習：`We will call once the shipment _____.`

答案：**arrives**。時間子句用現在式 arrives。

### 規則 5｜主詞一致與分詞修飾

together with 不改變主要主詞單複數；過去分詞可作被動修飾。

> The shipment, together with two samples, is ready.

練習：`The shipment, along with spare parts, _____ ready.`

答案：**is**。主要主詞 shipment 為單數。

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Replacement Units and Unconfirmed Dispatch
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: Have you finished testing the replacement units? Woman: Not all of them. Six passed inspection, but two are still undergoing battery checks. Man: The distributor asked whether all eight can ship tomorrow. Woman: I'd rather not promise that. If the remaining tests pass by four this afternoon, shipping can collect all eight tomorrow morning. Otherwise, we'll send the six cleared units and tell the distributor the other two will follow on Friday. Man: Should I update the delivery tracker now? Woman: Add a provisional note, but don't mark the order complete.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Equipment Training Room Comparison
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: Our training session has twenty-eight participants and must run Thursday from nine until noon. We also need wheelchair access and equipment to record the session. We can't spend more than five hundred forty dollars. Man: Birch is affordable, but it has no recording equipment. Lotus meets the budget, though it isn't available until ten. Summit has all the facilities, but its fee is five hundred sixty-five dollars. Woman: Then Orion looks right. Please hold it until Tuesday at noon, when our trainer will confirm the agenda.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Updated Mandatory Orientation
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, new employees. Due to a temporary registration-portal outage, the deadline for signing up for the mandatory orientation has been extended from Tuesday at five P.M. to Wednesday at noon. The orientation itself has also been rescheduled from Thursday at three P.M. to Friday at nine A.M. If you have already registered, you do not need to register again. Updated course materials will be available for download after two P.M. on Thursday. Some automatic reminders may still show the original schedule; please follow this announcement instead.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Discount Threshold, Delivery Delay, and Credit Memo
sections.markdown:
限時：**10 分 0 秒**。

### Northline Components — Standard Sales Terms

> Standard filter cartridges cost $85 each. Orders of 20 or more cartridges receive a 12% discount on the cartridge subtotal only. A calibration kit costs $160 and is never discounted. Standard freight is $75 per shipment. Rush handling adds $45, but only if the order is marked RUSH. When a shipment arrives more than two business days after its promised delivery date, the buyer receives a $100 credit on the next invoice, not on the delayed shipment's invoice. Customers may change quantities without an administrative fee through March 10. Later changes normally incur a $30 administrative fee unless the vendor initiates a delivery-schedule change.

用途：參考文件

### Westbridge Laboratory — Purchase Summary

> On March 6, Westbridge Laboratory ordered 20 filter cartridges and one calibration kit with standard freight; rush handling was not requested. The original promised delivery date was March 18. Westbridge's budget for this invoice is $1,750. On March 11, the purchasing team considered reducing the cartridge count to 18, but did not submit a change request. The team is comparing the two possible order totals before deciding whether a quantity revision would be worthwhile.

用途：參考文件

### Vendor Update and Delivery Confirmation

> On March 12, Northline notified Westbridge that delivery would be delayed until March 24. Because this change was initiated by Northline, Westbridge could confirm a revised quantity through March 13 without paying the usual $30 administrative fee. Northline would keep the original order of 20 cartridges unless Westbridge confirmed a change. No quantity change was received. All 20 cartridges and the calibration kit arrived on March 24, four business days after the original promised date. Northline confirmed that a $100 credit memo will be applied to Westbridge's next invoice. The current invoice will not be reduced.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑨ Day 42 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 39、Day 40、Day 41**。

### 複習重點
- **更新公告**：區分 originally / revised / still valid / supersedes。
- **折扣門檻**：比較 20 件打折與 18 件不打折，另外計算套件與運費。
- **抵用額適用期**：區分 current invoice 與 next invoice。
- **時間子句**：使用 as soon as / once / until 各造兩句。
- **間接回應**：說明 I'd rather not promise that 的含義與下一步。

### 錯題標籤
- `G`：一般文法
- `CAUS`：使役動詞
- `MODAL`：情態動詞與過去推論
- `TIME`：時間與期限
- `PURPOSE`：目的子句
- `L`：聽力理解
- `DETAIL`：細節
- `IMP`：隱含意圖
- `I`：跨句整合
- `U`：更新公告
- `N`：下一步行動
- `CAL`：費用計算
- `THRESHOLD`：折扣門檻
- `BUD`：預算限制
- `E`：例外條款

questions.prompt: What is the cartridge subtotal for 20 units before the discount?
What is the discounted price of the 20 cartridges?
What is the current invoice total for the unchanged order?
What would the total have been for 18 cartridges, one kit, and standard freight, excluding any administrative fee?

questions.explanation: 供應商主動更改交期，免行政費期限延至 3 月 13 日。

questions.prompt: How will the $100 credit be handled?

options.A: It will reduce the current invoice.
options.B: It will be paid in cash on March 24.
options.C: It will replace the freight charge.
options.D: It will be applied to the next invoice.

questions.explanation: 抵用額適用下一張發票，不減少目前帳單。

questions.prompt: We had the damaged sensors _____ by a certified technician.
questions.explanation: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞：had the sensors repaired。

questions.prompt: The manager got the carrier _____ the revised tracking number.
questions.explanation: get + 人 + to V：got the carrier to send。

questions.prompt: The warehouse has _____ space for an additional pallet.
questions.explanation: 名詞 space 前使用形容詞 sufficient。

questions.prompt: _____ the updated manifest, the delivery includes 24 cartons.
questions.explanation: According to + 名詞片語表示「根據」。

questions.prompt: The team completed the inspection _____ the goods could be released.
questions.explanation: so that + 完整子句表目的。

questions.prompt: The engineer must have _____ the attachment; the signature page is missing.
questions.explanation: must have + p.p. 表示對過去的推測。

questions.prompt: The shipment, together with two spare parts, _____ scheduled to arrive Friday.
questions.explanation: 主要主詞 shipment 為單數；together with 不改變主詞數量。

questions.prompt: Several replacement parts _____ already been dispatched.
questions.explanation: 主詞 parts 為複數，現在完成被動為 have been dispatched。

questions.prompt: Please notify the client as soon as the test results _____ available.
questions.explanation: 未來時間子句使用現在式 become。

questions.prompt: The operator is responsible _____ calibrating the device.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 responsible for + V-ing。

questions.prompt: The updated checklist is more _____ than the previous version.
questions.explanation: more + 形容詞 comprehensive。

questions.prompt: The goods were stored in a secure area _____ they could be inspected.
questions.explanation: until + 子句表示暫存至可以檢驗為止。

questions.prompt: We need a supplier _____ can deliver by Thursday.
questions.explanation: 指 supplier 的關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，可用 that。

questions.prompt: The parts were labeled clearly to prevent them from _____ mixed up.
questions.explanation: prevent ... from + V-ing；被混淆用 being mixed up。

questions.prompt: The purchase order cannot be finalized _____ the finance director signs it.
questions.explanation: not ... until 表示在簽署前不能完成訂單。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [1]?

options.D: The warehouse was painted last winter.

questions.prompt: Which phrase best completes blank [2]?

questions.prompt: Which transition best completes blank [3]?
questions.explanation: 新規定適用週一起的新申請，但舊標籤仍暫時有效，用 However。

options.A: The meeting room can hold thirty people.
options.B: The replacement item is always free of charge.
options.C: It may be needed if the package is delayed or misplaced.
options.D: The delivery company changed its logo last year.

questions.explanation: It 指 authorization email 的副本；包裹延誤或遺失時可能需要。

questions.prompt: We had the equipment _____ before the inspection.
questions.explanation: have + 物 + p.p. 表示安排別人校準。

questions.prompt: The carrier must have _____ the wrong label on the package.
questions.explanation: must have + p.p. 推測過去事件。

questions.prompt: The replacement will be shipped as soon as the inspection _____ complete.
questions.explanation: 未來時間子句 as soon as 用現在式 is。

questions.prompt: The report was written _____ the client could review the results.
questions.explanation: so that + 完整子句表示目的。
